description: This file contains the implementation of a standalone silo host used for testing within the Orleans distributed actor framework. It manages startup, shutdown, process monitoring, and logging for silo instances in a test environment.

classes.name: StandaloneSiloHost
classes.description: A static class serving as the entry point for standalone silo processes in Orleans testing environment, providing methods for startup, shutdown, and process monitoring.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Asynchronous entry point method that initializes and starts the silo host based on provided configuration arguments, manages shutdown signals, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: MonitorParentProcess
methods.description: Starts monitoring a parent process by process ID, triggering shutdown if the parent process exits.

methods.name: ListenForShutdownCommand
methods.description: Starts a background task to listen for shutdown commands from standard input and cancels the token source upon receiving a shutdown command.

methods.name: WhenCancelled
methods.description: Extension method for CancellationToken that returns a task that completes when the token is canceled.
